app.tagline: A global art marketplace, discovered by walking through it.

home.heroTitle: A trusted global marketplace for art from underrepresented regions.
home.heroBody: Buyers walk through curator-built virtual galleries, preview art in their own room with AR, and buy with confidence. Artists reach a global audience and get paid safely.

register.subtitle: One account to browse, bid, buy, and sell.

login.subtitle: Sign in to your {brand} account.

verify.pendingBody: Open the link we sent to confirm your email. In development, check the MailHog inbox at http://localhost:8025.

verify.expiredBody: Verification links last 30 minutes. Ask for a new one.

banner.unverifiedTitle: Verify your email to unlock bidding and buying.
